The user asks: "Which actors played Spider-man in the latest live-action Spider-man movie, and who directed their respective Spider-man movies?" Need to interpret. The latest live-action Spider-Man movie(s). As of now (2025). The latest Spider-Man live-action movies: "Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse" is animated, not live-action. Live-action: "Spider-Man: No Way Home" (2021), "Spider-Man: Far From Home" (2019), "Spider-Man: Homecoming" (2017). Also "Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse" is animated. Also there is "Spider-Man: The Amazing Spider-Man" series (2012, 2014). The phrase "latest live-action Spider-man movie" maybe refers to the most recent one released. As of 2025, maybe there is a new Spider-Man movie in 2024? Actually there is "Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse" (2024) but that's animated. There is "Spider-Man: Freshman Year"? Not live-action. There is "Spider-Man: The New World"? Not sure. Let's check: In 2023, there was "Spider-Man: No Way Home" in 2021. In 2024, maybe "Spider-Man: The Phantom" (speculative). I think the latest live-action Spider-Man film is "Spider-Man: No Way Home" (2021). But there is upcoming "Spider-Man: The Amazing Spider-Man 3"? Not released. Alternatively, there is a new Spider-Man film "Spider-Man: Freshman Year"? That's an animated series.

Thus likely answer: Actors: Tom Holland (Spider-Man in No Way Home, Homecoming, Far From Home). Also Tobey Maguire (Spider-Man in No Way Home as cameo). Also Andrew Garfield (Spider-Man in No Way Home cameo). The question: "Which actors played Spider-man in the latest live-action Spider-man movie, and who directed their respective Spider-man movies?" Could be interpreted that the latest live-action Spider-Man movie has multiple actors playing Spider-Man (like No Way Home includes three). So need to list each actor and the director of their own Spider-Man movies (i.e., the movies where they starred as Spider-Man). So:

- Tom Holland – starred in Homecoming (directed by Jon Watts), Far From Home (Jon Watts), No Way Home (Jon Watts). So director: Jon Watts.

- Tobey Maguire – starred in Spider-Man (2002), Spider-Man 2 (2004), Spider-Man 3 (2007). All directed by Sam Raimi.

- Andrew Garfield – starred in The Amazing Spider-Man (2012), The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (2014). Both directed by Marc Webb.
